```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(stringr)
  library(scales)
  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(readr)
  library(pheatmap)
})

obj <- readRDS(file.path("results", "processed_combined_obj.rds"))
fig_dir <- "figures"
out_dir <- file.path("results", "myeloid")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
myeloid_parent_clusters <- c(
  "Inflammatory Early Neutrophils",
  "Mature CXCR2+ Neutrophils",
  "Neutrophils (Metamyelocyte)",
  "Neutrophils (Promyelocytes)",
  "Granulocyte-Monocyte Progenitors (GMPs)",
  "Classical Monocytes",
  "Proliferating Myeloid Progenitors",
  "Macrophages",
  "Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cells",
  "Resident Macrophages"
)

MyeloidSubset <- subset(obj, idents = myeloid_parent_clusters)
DefaultAssay(MyeloidSubset) <- "RNA"

MyeloidSubset <- FindVariableFeatures(
  MyeloidSubset,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2000
)
MyeloidSubset <- RunPCA(
  MyeloidSubset,
  features = VariableFeatures(MyeloidSubset)
)
MyeloidSubset <- FindNeighbors(MyeloidSubset, dims = 1:15)
MyeloidSubset <- FindClusters(MyeloidSubset, resolution = 0.5)
MyeloidSubset <- RunUMAP(MyeloidSubset, dims = 1:15)
```

```{r}
myeloid_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  MyeloidSubset,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
write_csv(myeloid_markers, file.path(out_dir, "myeloid_cluster_markers.csv"))

myeloid_ids <- c(
  "0" = "Retnlg-hi Neut",
  "1" = "Ltf+ ImmNeu",
  "2" = "Band Neu",
  "3" = "Classical Mono",
  "4" = "Inflam Neut",
  "5" = "cMOP",
  "6" = "Pre-Neut",
  "7" = "GMPs",
  "8" = "ProMyel",
  "9" = "pDCs",
  "10" = "Lipid Mac",
  "11" = "Iron Mac"
)

MyeloidSubset <- RenameIdents(MyeloidSubset, myeloid_ids)
MyeloidSubset$myeloid_cell_type <- as.character(Idents(MyeloidSubset))
myeloid_order <- unname(myeloid_ids)
myeloid_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(myeloid_order)), myeloid_order)
```

```{r}
MyeloidSubset$cluster_number <- factor(
  MyeloidSubset$seurat_clusters,
  levels = names(myeloid_ids)
)

number_colors <- setNames(myeloid_colors[myeloid_ids], names(myeloid_ids))
number_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(names(myeloid_ids), " : ", myeloid_ids),
  names(myeloid_ids)
)

p_umap <- DimPlot(
  MyeloidSubset,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "cluster_number",
  split.by = "SampleGroup",
  ncol = 4,
  label = TRUE,
  label.size = 5,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 1
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = number_colors,
    breaks = names(myeloid_ids),
    labels = number_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), ncol = 1)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

p_umap
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4A_myeloid_UMAP.png"), p_umap,
       width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
composition <- tibble(
  SampleGroup = MyeloidSubset$SampleGroup,
  Cluster = factor(MyeloidSubset$myeloid_cell_type, levels = myeloid_order)
) %>%
  count(SampleGroup, Cluster, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(SampleGroup) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_composition <- ggplot(composition, aes(SampleGroup, prop, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = myeloid_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of myeloid cells", fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_composition
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4B_myeloid_composition.png"), p_composition,
       width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
prep_deg <- function(deg) {
  deg %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), nchar(gene) > 0, is.finite(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    slice_min(p_val_adj, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
}

run_de <- function(tissue_name) {
  sub <- subset(
    MyeloidSubset,
    cells = colnames(MyeloidSubset)[MyeloidSubset$tissue == tissue_name]
  )
  Idents(sub) <- factor(sub$condition, levels = c("VEH", "THC"))

  deg <- FindMarkers(
    sub,
    ident.1 = "THC",
    ident.2 = "VEH",
    assay = "RNA",
    test.use = "wilcox",
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0
  )

  prep_deg(deg)
}

deg_femoral <- run_de("Femoral")
deg_calvarial <- run_de("Calvarial")

write_csv(deg_femoral, file.path(out_dir, "Femoral_myeloid_THC_vs_VEH_DEG.csv"))
write_csv(deg_calvarial, file.path(out_dir, "Calvarial_myeloid_THC_vs_VEH_DEG.csv"))
```

```{r}
make_volcano <- function(deg, tissue_name) {
  padj_cut <- 0.05
  lfc_cut <- 0.25

  df <- deg %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10padj = -log10(pmax(p_val_adj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      group = case_when(
        p_val_adj <= padj_cut & avg_log2FC >= lfc_cut ~ "Up in THC",
        p_val_adj <= padj_cut & avg_log2FC <= -lfc_cut ~ "Down in THC",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )

  label_genes <- df %>%
    filter(p_val_adj <= padj_cut, abs(avg_log2FC) >= lfc_cut) %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    pull(gene)

  df$label <- ifelse(df$gene %in% label_genes, df$gene, NA_character_)

  ggplot(df, aes(avg_log2FC, neglog10padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = group), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Down in THC" = "#0072B2",
      "Not significant" = "grey80",
      "Up in THC" = "#D55E00"
    )) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(df, !is.na(label)),
      aes(label = label),
      size = 3.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0
    ) +
    labs(
      title = tissue_name,
      x = expression(log[2]~Fold~Change~(THC/VEH)),
      y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~italic(p))
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}

p_femoral_volcano <- make_volcano(deg_femoral, "Femoral myeloid")
p_calvarial_volcano <- make_volcano(deg_calvarial, "Calvarial myeloid")

p_femoral_volcano
p_calvarial_volcano

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4C_femoral_myeloid_volcano.png"),
       p_femoral_volcano, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4E_calvarial_myeloid_volcano.png"),
       p_calvarial_volcano, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", collection = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
hallmark_sets <- split(hallmark$gene_symbol, hallmark$gs_name)

run_gsea <- function(deg, tissue_name) {
  ranks <- setNames(deg$avg_log2FC, deg$gene)
  set.seed(123)
  fg <- fgsea(
    pathways = hallmark_sets,
    stats = ranks,
    minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 1000,
    nperm = 10000
  ) %>%
    arrange(padj)

  plot_df <- fg %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = str_remove(pathway, "^HALLMARK_") %>% str_replace_all("_", " "),
      mlogFDR = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      Pathway = factor(Pathway, levels = Pathway)
    )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(NES, Pathway)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NES, yend = Pathway), alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(size = mlogFDR, color = NES)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2676B8", mid = "grey90", high = "#CB3E38", midpoint = 0) +
    labs(title = tissue_name, x = "Normalized enrichment score", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)

  list(table = fg, plot = p)
}

gsea_femoral <- run_gsea(deg_femoral, "Femoral myeloid")
gsea_calvarial <- run_gsea(deg_calvarial, "Calvarial myeloid")

write_csv(gsea_femoral$table, file.path(out_dir, "Femoral_myeloid_Hallmark_GSEA.csv"))
write_csv(gsea_calvarial$table, file.path(out_dir, "Calvarial_myeloid_Hallmark_GSEA.csv"))

gsea_femoral$plot
gsea_calvarial$plot

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4D_femoral_myeloid_GSEA.png"),
       gsea_femoral$plot, width = 7.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4F_calvarial_myeloid_GSEA.png"),
       gsea_calvarial$plot, width = 7.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
isg_panel <- c(
  "Ifi27l2a", "Ifitm3", "Isg15", "Irf7", "Rsad2", "Stat1", "Ifit3",
  "Zbp1", "Oas3", "Usp18", "Gbp2", "Ifih1", "B2m", "H2-K1", "H2-Q7", "H2-D1"
)

MyeloidSubset <- AddModuleScore(
  MyeloidSubset,
  features = list(isg_panel),
  name = "ISGscore"
)

p_isg_score <- FeaturePlot(
  MyeloidSubset,
  features = "ISGscore1",
  reduction = "umap",
  split.by = "SampleGroup",
  cols = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "grey95", "#B2182B"))(100),
  pt.size = 1,
  min.cutoff = "q10",
  max.cutoff = "q90",
  order = TRUE
)

p_isg_score
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4H_myeloid_ISG_score.png"),
       p_isg_score, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
groups <- levels(MyeloidSubset$SampleGroup)

deg_by_group <- lapply(groups, function(group_name) {
  x <- FindMarkers(
    MyeloidSubset,
    ident.1 = group_name,
    group.by = "SampleGroup",
    assay = "RNA",
    slot = "data",
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0
  )

  tibble(
    SampleGroup = group_name,
    gene = rownames(x),
    avg_log2FC = x$avg_log2FC
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

isg_mat <- deg_by_group %>%
  filter(gene %in% isg_panel) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SampleGroup,
    values_from = avg_log2FC,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

lim <- max(abs(isg_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
breaks <- seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101)
palette <- colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))(100)

png(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4G_myeloid_ISG_heatmap.png"),
    width = 2100, height = 2100, res = 300)
pheatmap(
  isg_mat,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = palette,
  breaks = breaks,
  fontsize = 11
)
dev.off()
```
